about: BOM수정 창 [H] 이력 + [Excel] (재고1 마무리13) — ITM-0003 에 QAH 버전을 API 로 만들고, 다중버전 › 그 버전을 열어 [H] 에 '신규', 사용중단 · 재사용 뒤에 다시 열면 그 줄들이 쌓인다. 만든 버전은 지운다.

JSON.stringify(b) : undefined }).then(async (r) => ({ status: r.status, body: await r.json().catch(() => null) })); true

js:(async()=>{const it=(await window.__api('GET','/items')).body;const p=it.find((x)=>x.code==='ITM-0003'),c=it.find((x)=>x.code==='ITM-0005');const r0=await window.__api('POST','/boms',{productId:p.id,versionName:'QAH0',produceQty:1,lines:[{componentId:c.id,quantity:1}]});sessionStorage.setItem('bomH0',String(r0.body.id));const r=await window.__api('POST','/boms',{productId:p.id,versionName:'QAH',produceQty:1,lines:[{componentId:c.id,quantity:2}]});sessionStorage.setItem('bomH',String(r.body.id));return r.status})()

js:(async()=>{const s=(t)=>new Promise((r)=>setTimeout(r,t));const r=[...document.querySelectorAll('tbody tr')].find((x)=>x.innerText.startsWith('ITM-0003'));r.cells[4].querySelector('button').click();await s(200);[...r.cells[4].querySelectorAll('button')].find((b)=>b.textContent==='다중버전').click();await s(700);const v=[...document.querySelectorAll('[role=dialog]')].pop();const tr=[...v.querySelectorAll('tbody tr')].find((t)=>t.innerText.includes('QAH'));tr.querySelector('button').click();await s(700);return true})()

js:window.__api = (m, p, b) => fetch('/api' + p, { method: m, headers: {Authorization:'Bearer '+localStorage.getItem('erp_token'),'Content-Type':'application/json'}, body: b ? JSON.stringify(b) : undefined }).then(async (r) => ({ status: r.status, body: await r.json().catch(() => null) })); true

js:(async()=>{const id=sessionStorage.getItem('bomH');const a=await window.__api('PATCH','/boms/'+id+'/active?active=false');const b=await window.__api('PATCH','/boms/'+id+'/active?active=true');const h=(await window.__api('GET','/change-history?target=BOM&id='+id)).body.map((x)=>x.action).join(',');sessionStorage.setItem('bomHh',h);return a.status+':'+b.status})()
